name: SuperHub-v3
desc:
SuperHub-v3 is a playful home screen for Supernote that looks like a retro handheld games console: the clock, date and battery on a pixel-art screen, and nine console buttons (D-pad, A, B, two pill buttons and the speaker) that you name and point at anything: folders, notes, apps, a new note, a new typed document, Favourites, Starred pages, Keywords, Search or SuperHub's settings.

Open it: in a note, tap the plugin button in the toolbar and choose SuperHub-v3. After that, tap the floating house on any screen. Tap the SUPERHUB lettering to change the buttons.

Needs file access to show and open your files and save settings. No internet.

Based on SuperDashboard by AgP42 (MIT licence): https://github.com/AgP42/SuperDashboard
